limitations: The classification is for Hermitian positive-definite gain B and positive-semidefinite H with spectrum in [0,1]; it does not cover general nonnormal gain coupling or indefinite fixed points.
The unique-sink criterion is local and hyperbolic, not a statement of global attraction.
At gain squares 1 and 3 the theorem gives nonhyperbolicity but does not classify nonlinear center behavior; higher-period orbits are not classified.
The unstable-index inversion formula assumes simple gain spectrum and all squared gains strictly between 1 and 3.
Priority remains subject to unindexed and inaccessible literature; independent mathematical validation has not been performed.
title: Coherence rigidity and an inversion-count unstable index for positive matrix logistic maps
